steps.en: Install it and build a renderer, ideally with your own fonts (and voice files for audio)
steps.zh: 安装后建一个渲染器，最好换上自己的字体（音频则换语音文件）

steps.en: Pick a random challenge string and keep the answer in your session
steps.zh: 自己生成随机验证码文本，把答案存进会话

steps.en: Ask it to render that string as an image or as audio
steps.zh: 让它把这串文本渲染成图片或音频

steps.en: Draws each character with a random font, rotation and warp, then adds noise dots and a curve
steps.zh: 每个字符随机挑字体、旋转、扭曲，再撒噪点、画干扰线

steps.en: Returns the PNG (or a noise-mixed WAV) as in-memory bytes and keeps no state
steps.zh: 把 PNG（或混了噪声的 WAV）以内存字节返回，不留任何状态

steps.en: Serve the bytes; on submit, compare the user's input with the stored answer
steps.zh: 把字节发给页面；提交时拿用户输入和存好的答案比对

value.en: A self-hosted image/audio CAPTCHA with no third-party call — only Pillow in your own process
value.zh: 自托管的图片/音频验证码，不调第三方，只在你自己进程里用 Pillow

sources: https://github.com/lepture/captcha#usage (pip install captcha, ImageCaptcha(fonts=[...]), AudioCaptcha(voicedir=...), image.generate('1234'), audio.generate('1234'))
https://github.com/lepture/captcha/blob/main/src/captcha/image.py (_draw_character: random font, rotate, warp; create_noise_dots / create_noise_curve; generate returns BytesIO)
